abstract: Cold storage is widely used to delay postharvest fruit ripening, yet the underlying epitranscriptomic mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the role of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification in cold-delayed ripening of peach (Prunus persica) fruit through physiological measurements, RNA sequencing, m6A sequencing, and functional assays in peach tissues and heterologous systems. Cold storage delayed ethylene production and fruit softening while restraining the physiological decline in global m6A abundance observed during normal ambient ripening. Integrative transcriptome and epitranscriptome profiling revealed widespread m6A remodeling coupled with altered transcript abundance during storage. PpALKBH9, a cold-suppressed m6A regulator, exhibited m6A demethylase activity both in vitro and in vivo. Functionally, PpALKBH9 overexpression enhanced ethylene production in peach, whereas silencing of PpALKBH9 reduced ethylene production. Moreover, PpALKBH9 overexpression accelerated fruit ripening in transgenic tomato. Meanwhile, PpALKBH9 reduced m6A enrichment at the PpFUL4 3' untranslated region and extended PpFUL4 mRNA half-life in peach. Consistent with these observations, cold storage increased m6A enrichment at the PpFUL4 3' untranslated region and reduced PpFUL4 transcript abundance. Moreover, PpFUL4 overexpression in peach fruit promoted ethylene production and increased the expression of ripening-related genes. Collectively, our findings support a model in which cold-repressed m6A demethylase PpALKBH9 modulates PpFUL4 transcript stability to promote postharvest ethylene biosynthesis, providing insights into epitranscriptomic regulation of fruit senescent physiology and offering potential targets for optimizing postharvest shelf-life.

summary: Cold storage delays peach ripening via m6A demethylase PpALKBH9, which stabilizes PpFUL4 mRNA and promotes ethylene biosynthesis.
title: A cold-repressed m6A demethylase PpALKBH9 modulates PpFUL4 transcript stability and ethylene-associated ripening in peach.
